title: That One Gray Pixel
description: Fixes that irritating grayish-yellow pixel on weathered copper bars and chains
body:
## ◽ That One Gray Pixel
Ever wanted to get rid of this annoying pixel?\
![The texture of weathered copper bars without the resource pack. There is an ugly, discolored pixel in the center of the texture.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609200b8126fd695121092e734de6da1513a2dfd.png)

Now you can! This resource pack recolors that weird grayish-yellowish pixel on weathered copper bars and chains to make them look much cleaner, especially when used in bulk.\
![The texture of weathered copper bars with the resource pack. The discolored pixel is gone, making the whole texture much more uniform.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc2b4a4e8b62a42a3e2ea34d0228e4c78ab4f829.png)

Weathered copper is definitely my favorite copper color, especially when it comes to all the new decoration blocks. When I noticed that weird pixel getting in the way of all things weathered copper-related, I had to fix it immediately.
